title: FFASR: Benchmarking Far-Field Automatic Speech Recognition using High-Fidelity Simulated RIRs
abstract: arXiv:2609.38897v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Far-field automatic speech recognition(ASR) degrades under reverberation, noise, and talker motion, yet the benchmarks that drive model selection emphasize close-microphone speech. We present FFASR, a held-out corpus of 15,637 utterances and an open leaderboard spanning nine conditions, each varying a single acoustic factor: anechoic near-field speech, a measured-versus-simulated office-lab pair, static far-field mixtures at high/mid/low signal-to-noise ratio(SNR), and moving-talker variants at matched SNR. Dry speech from 15 talkers is convolved with hybrid wave/geometrical-acoustics room impulse responses from 14 furnished rooms; because the speech is newly recorded and the test waveforms are never released, the corpus resists training-data contamination. Across contemporary systems, mean word error rate (WER) rises from 4.4% near-field to 41.3% in the static low-SNR condition; a moving talker adds a small but consistent penalty at m

translated_title: FFASR：使用高保真模拟房间脉冲响应的远场自动语音识别基准测试
translated_abstract: 远场自动语音识别（ASR）在混响、噪声和说话人移动等因素影响下性能会显著下降，然而目前驱动模型选择的主流基准测试却侧重于近讲语音。我们提出了FFASR，这是一个包含15,637条语音的留出（held-out）评测语料库，并配有涵盖九种条件的开放排行榜，每种条件仅变化单一声学因素：无混响近场语音、实测与模拟办公实验室的配对条件、高/中/低信噪比（SNR）下的静态远场混合语音，以及信噪比匹配的移动说话人变体。来自15名说话人的干语音（dry speech）与来自14个配备家具房间的混合波动/几何声学房间脉冲响应（RIR）进行卷积；由于语音为全新录制且测试波形从不公开，该语料库能够有效抵御训练数据污染。在当代各类系统中，平均词错误率（WER）从近场条件下的4.4%上升到静态低信噪比条件下的41.3%；在相同信噪比下，移动说话人还带来了小幅但持续的额外性能损失。
tldr: 该论文提出了FFASR基准——一个利用高保真混合声学模拟房间脉冲响应构建的、通过全新录制并永不公开测试波形来抵御训练数据污染的远场语音识别评测语料库，揭示了远场低信噪比条件下词错误率从近场的4.4%飙升至41.3%的巨大性能差距。
en_tdlr: FFASR introduces a contamination-resistant far-field ASR benchmark built with high-fidelity hybrid wave/geometrical-acoustics simulated room impulse responses across nine single-factor acoustic conditions, revealing that mean word error rate jumps from 4.4% in near-field speech to 41.3% under low-SNR far-field conditions.
